objective: Make Cloud IaC provider signer-key review a first-class fail-closed local Oya gate by binding OpenTofu providers-lock signer output to the committed providers.tofu and .terraform.lock.hcl digests, manifest scope, provider sources, selected versions, constraints, required platforms, and explicit no-VSA/no-SLSA/no-signing/no-install/no-plan-apply/cloud non-claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: OpenTofu documents that providers lock writes dependency lock information, supports repeated -platform values, prints signed package/signing-key information, and requires signer review before committing.
The committed .terraform.lock.hcl is treated as reviewable provider dependency-selection and checksum evidence, not as a provider installation or trust-complete provenance claim.
The review records registry provider signing key IDs while preserving the distinction between OpenTofu plugin authentication and independent provenance/SLSA attestations.
VSA fields and verification steps remain explicit future non-claims; this ChangeSet emits no VSA and verifies no SLSA attestation.

implemented_claims: Added oya gate validate cloud-iac-provider-signature-review with repo-local defaults for manifest, provider lock root, and provider-signature-review paths.

The gate verifies review authority paths, policy booleans, official-source anchors, artifact SHA-256 digests, providers.tofu requirements, .terraform.lock.hcl selected versions/constraints, signed provider statuses, uppercase signer key IDs, and signed retrieval rows per required platform.

explicit_non_claims: no independent cryptographic provider signature verification beyond OpenTofu providers-lock output review
no provider provenance verification summary or VSA
no SLSA attestation generation or verification
no module signing, Sigstore, or cosign execution
no provider installation in source tree or .terraform provider cache
no provider API calls or cloud resource provisioning

false_green_findings_closed: Provider signer-key review can no longer be implied by lockfile existence alone; it is now a machine-checkable JSON review bound to local artifact digests and manifest scope.
Manifest cannot silently drift from the review because provider sources, selected versions, signer key IDs, artifact digests, platforms, status, runtime mode, and official-source anchors are checked.
Unsigned provider rows, missing platform retrieval rows, and digest drift fail closed in focused tests.
The gate records no VSA/SLSA/provider-provenance claim and forces all such policy booleans to remain false for this slice.

Cloud IaC still needs future slices for independent provider provenance/VSA verification, signed module release index, SLSA attestations, tofu tests, plan/apply evidence, private module registry API, live GitOps/provider integration evidence, and provider-resource-complete modules.
